messages:
nisha_ops: pushed ~150 BMC fw updates to eu-west-1 (batch: r13-r15) at 02:02 UTC, noticing a spike in IPMI sessions and some OOB network saturation. nodes are flapping in groups of 5-8. anyobs?
liam_infra: seeing same, lots of `ipmi` sessions stuck. OOB switch counters show heavy TCP:2381 (ipmi) from multiple BMCs.
maría_sre: (typo) maria_sre: logs show repeated `sol` sessions in `sshd` logs on the IBMC gateway, CPU of gw01 hitting 98%.
oncall-asia: impact: 12 GPU nodes lost reachable OOB for ~3-12m, some auto-rebooted, allocation engine marked them unhealthy so we lost ~320 GPU-minutes of reserved capacity. moving in-progress jobs to queue.fallback now.
deploy-bot: deploy event: firmware v2025-04-08-1 pushed to eu-west-1/r13 (canary 10 -> roll 150)
sre-bot: alert: OOB_NET_UTIL > 90% on gw01 (eu-west-1). auto-throttle engaged.
liam_infra: here's a quick check - run on gw01: 
```
# ipmitool lan print 1
IP Address              : 10.12.34.1
Subnet Mask             : 255.255.248.0
MAC Address             : 02:42:ac:11:00:02
`Connection Status`     : ACTIVE
`Active Sessions`       : 47
```
we've been seeing Active Sessions spike past 200 on gw01 earlier.
maría_sre: confirmed firmware change included IPMI session keepalive change and an extra debug agent that opens sockets for telemetry; possible leak under high concurrency.
oncall-asia: is secure boot involved? any toggles? customers complaining about nodes not booting into host OS.
nisha_ops: checked node BMC configs - secureboot flag unchanged. BIOS flash step succeeded for all canary nodes. no secureboot toggles were included in the fw bundle.
liam_infra: recommended action: 1) pause rollout immediately, 2) trigger rollback to v2025-03-30-5 (last stable), 3) drain and reprovision gw01 with restart of the IPMI proxy. Can we do 1-2 now?
alex_provisioning: starting rollback job now (rolling, 10/s). also opening a small canary on us-west to validate no regression.
maría_sre: note — draining will evict some jobs; cost impact estimate: ~400 GPU-minutes x avg $0.09/min = ~$36 on this incident (rough). tagging finance/ticket later.
sre-bot: rollback job queued id=rb-2025-1779012345, ETA start 02:17 UTC. auto-notify on failure.
liam_infra: while rolling back, can someone run `tcpdump -i oob0 port 623` on gw01 and collect a 1m capture? need to check malformed session teardown patterns.
nisha_ops: grabbing capture now, uploading to //artifacts/redwood/incidents/1779012345/pktcap.pcap.gz
oncall-asia: what's the postmortem ownership? I can lead with liam and maria as co-authors.
alex_provisioning: rollback started, first batch (10) completed, gw01 freed up some sessions, CPU down to 40%.
maría_sre: after rollback, BMCs are stable; canary nodes passed boot validation. I recommend we: a) revert rollout and mark fw version as blocked, b) create a hotfix that removes telemetry socket agent, c) add OOB canary limit to 20 nodes per gateway.
liam_infra: agreed. also let's add a preflight that simulates concurrent SOL sessions (50+) before any mass rollouts.
deploy-bot: note added to release: blocked=true, reason="IPMI session leak leading to OOB saturation"
maría_sre: adding follow-ups to ticket INC-2025-0456 (postmortem + cost + rollout checklist).
liam_infra: thx. please ping when postmortem draft is up. :eyes:
